title: Joshua
author: Traditionally attributed largely to Joshua, with later inspired editing possibly accounting for the final form.
date: After Israel's wilderness journey, commonly connected with the conquest period in the late second millennium B.C.
audience: Israel entering and settling the land promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
historicalSetting: Joshua records Israel's entrance into Canaan after Moses' death, the conquest of key cities, distribution of the land, and the call to covenant faithfulness.
keyVerse: Joshua 1:9 — "Haven't I commanded you? Be strong and courageous."
christFocus: Joshua points to Christ as the greater Joshua who brings His people into the true inheritance of salvation and rest. The victories and inheritance anticipate the fuller deliverance secured through Jesus Christ.
